title: Logarithmic Entanglement Enhancement from Partial Delocalization
exact_target: How much partial delocalization is enough to create logarithmically enhanced free-fermion entanglement, even without absolutely continuous spectrum?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004241 (OWR-17137-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Many-Body Quantum Systems (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/41, pp. 2541--2603. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 21, 22.
Muller, Pastur, and Schulte (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The primary report (PDF pages 21--22) already gives a random-dimer example with logarithmic enhancement without absolutely continuous spectrum. The remaining inherited question asks for how much delocalization and a general criterion; mere existence in one such model is known context, not a freshly verified open subproblem.
